theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ) (x : Euclidean N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Euclidean N)) (r₀ : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 ≤ θ y) → x ∈ M → 0 < r₀ → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall x r₀) μHE[n] → Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P → HasDensity n (((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict M).withDensity fun y ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (θ y)) x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))
